calculation.expression: signal_i(t) = -(log(close_i(t-1)/close_i(t-11)) - cross_sectional_mean_j[log(close_j(t-1)/close_j(t-11)]) ) when cross_sectional_dispersion_10d(t-1) > rolling_median_60d(dispersion_10d)(t-1), otherwise null
calculation.description: Ranks assets for 10-trading-day relative reversal only during high cross-asset dispersion. The signal fades each asset's lagged 10-day return relative to the contemporaneous equal-weight universe return; inactive dates have no signal rather than an artificial zero. Forward validation horizon is 10 trading days.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate and recent performance; 2028-2030 subperiod was negative, so monitor regime dependence. Conditional activation produces low unconditional coverage but complete cross-section on active dates.
